# Fernhill Tea Co. Returns, Refunds and Order Changes

## Returns

- Unopened tea can be returned within 30 days of delivery. For food-safety reasons we cannot take back tea once its seal is broken.
- Teaware can be returned within 30 days of delivery if it is unused and in its original packaging.
- The customer pays for return shipping, unless the item arrived damaged or we sent the wrong item.

## Refunds

Refunds go back to the original payment method within 5 business days of the return arriving at our warehouse. Shipping costs of the original order are refunded only when the whole order is returned because of our mistake.

## Damaged or wrong items

If an item arrives damaged, or we sent the wrong item, report it within 7 days of delivery with a photo. We then send a replacement or refund the item, whichever the customer prefers, and the customer does not need to send the item back.

## Changing or cancelling an order

An order can be changed or cancelled free of charge until it leaves the warehouse. Changes and cancellations are made by our customer care team: write to us with your order number and a team member confirms the change by email. Once an order has left the warehouse it cannot be cancelled, but it can be returned under the returns policy.
